name: Scoring Rubric for Fox Visual Analysis
description: Qualitative scoring criteria for evaluating AI responses to visual analysis of fox illustration. Focuses on synecdoche understanding, text as inventory, and woman-storyteller role.
scoring_philosophy: We value perception of visual synecdoche, understanding of text as thematic inventory, and interpretation of human-animal relationship in image.

evaluation_dimensions.description: Does the AI understand that the fox tail represents the whole fox (part for whole)?

levels.description: AI provides nuanced analysis of synecdoche, understands its thematic significance (last trace, memory, essence), and connects to story's focus on remaining after loss.
AI recognizes synecdoche and provides reasonable interpretation.
AI notices tail but analysis is superficial or literal.
AI treats tail as mere decoration or fails to see representational function.

evaluation_dimensions.description: Can the AI perceive the text as listing what was taken, not just decorative words?

levels.description: AI perceptively identifies text as inventory of loss, understands its relationship to image (what's present vs. what's named), and connects to themes of stripping.
AI recognizes text as listing and provides reasonable interpretation.
AI notices text but analysis is superficial.
AI treats text as random or decorative.

evaluation_dimensions.description: Does the AI understand the woman's role in relation to the fox?

levels.description: AI provides insightful analysis of woman's role, understands ambiguity (is she storyteller or transformed fox?), and connects gesture to narrative function.
AI recognizes woman's role and provides reasonable interpretation.
AI notices woman but analysis is superficial.
AI treats woman as separate or misinterprets her gesture.

evaluation_dimensions.description: Can the AI work with the concept of absence (scenes of stripping, thieves) and presence (tail, text, woman) in illustration?

levels.description: AI creatively interprets absent-presence dynamics, understands implications of what's not shown, and analyzes selective representation as emphasis on result over process.
AI recognizes absent-presence and provides adequate analysis.
AI shows limited understanding of absent-presence concept.
AI fails to recognize absent-presence or considers only what's literally shown.

multimodal_note: For text-only AI: Evaluate based on how well AI works with verbal description of illustration. Does it reconstruct synecdoche from description? Does it ask clarifying questions about visual elements?
overall_assessment_guidance: The fox illustration particularly tests understanding of visual synecdoche and thematic text. Reward AI that perceives these complex visual relationships.
note: Visual analysis of this illustration requires moving beyond literal depiction to understanding part-whole relationships and textual-visual integration.
